introduction.zh: 你想在虚构合作冒险中怎样参与？24道原创情境借SRD5.2.1十二类基础职业，比较原初力量、表演支援、神圣魔法、自然形态、武技、身法、誓言、路线、精细切口、自身魔法、契约与研习。十二份完整说明可先读，最高并列全部完整显示。这里的职业指游戏职业，不评现实人格、能力、就业或信仰，也不替你生成角色卡。
introduction.en: How would you like to participate in a fictional cooperative adventure? Twenty-four original situations compare primal power, performance, divine support, nature and forms, martial technique, agile movement, an oath, routes, precise openings, innate magic, a pact and study through twelve SRD 5.2.1 base classes. Read all twelve full guides first and see every highest tie in full. Class means a game class rather than actual personality, ability, employment or belief, and no playable character sheet is generated.

instructions.zh: 24道原创奇幻游戏情境题，比较SRD5.2.1中的十二类基础职业游玩偏好：野蛮人、吟游诗人、牧师、德鲁伊、战士、武僧、圣武士、游侠、游荡者、术士、邪术师与法师。每题选一个更想在虚构合作故事里扮演的做法，不按现实里会不会、强不强回答；可以先读十二份完整说明。每选加1，每类出现8次、每位置2次，总数24；最高并列全部完整显示。职业指游戏职业，不是现实就业建议；不评属性、能力、善恶、信仰或心理，不是官方测验，也不从结果生成实际角色卡或换算MBTI。
instructions.en: Twenty-four original fantasy-game situations compare play preferences for the twelve SRD 5.2.1 base classes: Barbarian, Bard, Cleric, Druid, Fighter, Monk, Paladin, Ranger, Rogue, Sorcerer, Warlock and Wizard. Choose an approach you would enjoy playing in a fictional cooperative story, rather than what you can actually do or how strong you are. Read all twelve full guides first if wanted. Each choice adds one; each class appears eight times, twice per position, and counts sum to twenty-four. Every highest tie appears in full. Class means a game class, not a real career. This unofficial quiz assesses no ability scores, skills, goodness, religious belief or psychology, produces no playable character sheet and converts into no MBTI type.

scoreReading.zh: 24题全部各选一项，对应的本版职业游玩角度加1，总数24。每题提供十二类中的四类，每类全卷出现8次、每位置2次，未提供的八类不记拒绝。最高计数全部保留完整说明；全选第一项会十二类各2次、十二份完整显示。名单顺序不设主次，不自动指定第二职业；次数不是相似百分比、属性值、战力、适配概率或人口排名。相差一次只是一项选择，不证明显著差异、天赋或固定身份。近分可以自行比较，不补造并列；并列也不自动建议兼职业。本版没有常模、稀有度、科学分界或心理测量验证，故事情境与理解改变时，选择也可以改变。
scoreReading.en: Choose one option for all 24 items; each adds one to its editorial class play angle and counts sum to 24. Four of twelve classes appear per item. Each appears eight times, twice in each position; absent classes are not rejections. Every highest count retains its full guide. Choosing the first option throughout gives two each and all twelve guides. List order establishes no priority or automatic second class. Counts are neither similarity percentages, ability scores, power, fit probabilities nor population ranks. One extra choice proves no significance, talent or fixed identity. Compare close guides without inventing ties; ties prescribe no multiclassing. This edition has no norms, rarity estimates, scientific cutoffs or psychometric validation. Changing stories and interpretations can change choices.

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，你在这组故事选项里较常选择直接投入、让原初力量成为画面中心。吸引你的可能是叙事鲜明、行动目标清楚，或暂时想演和平时不同的人物。计数不区分动机，也不测耐力、勇气、冲动或操作难度。喜欢这种幻想与现实中谨慎、安静或不喜欢冲突可以同时存在。
paragraphs.en: A highest count records more choices for direct commitment and primal power within these imagined scenes. A vivid premise, clear action or a character unlike your everyday self might explain the appeal. Counts distinguish none of those motives and measure no endurance, bravery, impulse or gameplay difficulty. The fantasy can appeal to someone who is ordinarily quiet, cautious or uninterested in actual conflict.

title.zh: 一个具体虚构场景
title.en: A concrete fictional scene

paragraphs.zh: 例如，虚构古门前出现阻碍，你想让角色以原初力量迎接挑战。讲清自己希望的故事画面，再由同桌按所用规则确认能做什么、是否需要检定和结果如何。问卷不生成动作数值，也不保证某职业能推开所有门。若这幕不适合直接处理，换一个办法并不让人物失去职业身份。
paragraphs.en: Imagine an obstacle before an old gate and a character bringing primal force to the challenge. Describe the scene you want, then let the table determine available actions and outcomes under its actual rules. This quiz supplies no mechanical values or guarantee that a class opens every door. Trying another approach in an unsuitable scene does not erase the fictional character’s class.

title.zh: 选角色前与同桌讨论
title.en: Questions to discuss with the table

paragraphs.zh: 选角色前可以问同桌：“这次故事是否留有直接行动的空间？我不想每个场景都只有这一种办法。”也可以确认更偏探索、交流还是战斗，避免把一段职业简介当完整体验。自己喜欢鲜明力量画面，不表示有义务带头、替所有人承担风险，或把角色冲突变成玩家之间的冲突。
paragraphs.en: Before choosing a character, ask whether the campaign leaves room for direct action without making it your only option. Check whether exploration, conversation or combat receives more attention; a short class guide cannot predict the whole experience. Enjoying a forceful image creates no duty to lead or take everyone’s risks, and fictional conflict need not become conflict between the players.

title.zh: 与其他十一类职业比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other eleven classes

paragraphs.zh: 最接近的战士偏练熟武技，武僧偏徒手身法与移动，野蛮人这里偏原初力量的直接投入。圣武士重誓言守护，游侠重荒野路线，游荡者重精细切入；吟游诗人偏表演支援，牧师偏神圣魔法，德鲁伊偏自然变化，术士偏自身魔法塑形，邪术师偏契约，法师偏研习准备。十二种没有现实力量、智力或善恶等级。
paragraphs.en: Fighter highlights practised technique and Monk unarmed movement, while this Barbarian angle highlights primal commitment. Paladin concerns an oath, Ranger wilderness routes and Rogue precise openings. Bard offers performance, Cleric divine support, Druid nature and forms, Sorcerer innate shaping, Warlock a pact and Wizard studied preparation. These are selected play angles, with no ranking of actual strength, intelligence or goodness.

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的能力
title.en: Counterexamples and abilities not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，你选直接行动可能只想让这一幕快点推进，不代表想长期玩同一角色；喜欢研习法术也不表示缺乏行动力。结果不判断愤怒、攻击性、心理疾病、文化、体能或工作适配。不同桌面的职业规则、允许材料与故事重点会改变体验，问卷不是建卡器或强度榜，最高并列也不自动表示兼职业。
paragraphs.en: Direct action might simply move this scene along rather than define a character you want for months. Enjoying spell study does not imply weak initiative. The result assesses no anger, aggression, mental illness, culture, fitness or occupational fit. Allowed material and campaign focus change actual play. This is no character builder or power ranking, and a highest tie does not automatically prescribe multiclassing.

title.zh: 可选的纸上小尝试
title.en: An optional imaginary tryout

paragraphs.zh: 可选小尝试：只在纸上写一个虚构障碍、一个想用原初力量处理的画面，以及一个愿意换别的方法的条件，不需要进行任何现实动作。看看你喜欢的是鲜明画面、直接参与，还是某个具体故事。若后来更想试战士或其他职业，也可以比较完整说明；一次问卷不替你锁定角色。
paragraphs.en: For an optional tryout, write a fictional obstacle, an imagined use of primal power and a condition for trying another approach. Perform no actual action. Notice whether the image, direct participation or a particular story appeals. Compare Fighter or another full guide if your interest changes; one questionnaire does not lock your next character or decide what you must enjoy at the table.

description.en: Read a D&D Bard result through performance, versatile support, table discussion, eleven comparisons and scoring, without actual charisma or music claims.

title.zh: 职业语境与本版游玩角度
title.en: Class context and this edition’s play angle

paragraphs.zh: 吟游诗人的奇幻职业语境把表演、魔法与多样支援放在一起。本版用这种游戏想象比较你想获得的戏份，不考乐器、唱歌或临场演说。玩家可以用一句描述代替真实表演，也可以喜欢安静地设计角色效果。职业幻想不要求你在现实里外向、有魅力、懂得操纵情绪或随时负责娱乐大家。
paragraphs.en: Bard brings performance, magic and varied support into the fictional class premise. This edition asks what part of that play appeals, without testing instruments, singing or improvised speeches. A brief description can stand in for performing, and quietly planning a character’s contribution can be enjoyable. The fantasy requires no actual extraversion, charisma, emotional manipulation or permanent responsibility for entertaining the group.

title.zh: 计数对应怎样的游玩选择
title.en: Which play choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，本次较常选择故事、表演或灵活支援的选项。可以问：你喜欢创造气氛、在不同场景有事可做，还是想用故事参与共同想象？这些偏好并不等同，计数也不会分开测量。真实玩家不需要像角色一样会表演；选择一种幻想，与证明自己具备某种社交或音乐能力是两件事。
paragraphs.en: A highest count records more choices for story, performance or versatile support. Perhaps atmosphere, participation across different scenes or a narrative contribution appeals. Those preferences differ and are not separately measured here. A player need not perform as skillfully as the imagined character. Choosing a fantasy and demonstrating a social or musical ability are separate activities, with neither established by this count.

title.zh: 一个具体虚构场景
title.en: A concrete fictional scene

paragraphs.zh: 例如，虚构队伍准备出发，你想让角色用一小段故事给同伴提气。可以概括“角色讲起上次一起完成的小冒险”，不必真的编完整歌。具体能否产生游戏效果、怎样使用资源，仍按同桌采用的规则确认。队友愿意听故事与获得某个规则效果也不同；问卷不把表演当万能解决方式。
paragraphs.en: Before a fictional party departs, imagine your Bard telling a brief story that supports companions. Summarise the idea rather than writing a complete song. Any mechanical effect, resource or action still depends on the table’s rules. Companions enjoying a story and receiving a game benefit are different matters. Performance is no universal solution, and this questionnaire promises neither a successful scene nor a particular outcome.

title.zh: 选角色前与同桌讨论
title.en: Questions to discuss with the table

paragraphs.zh: 可以与同桌说：“我喜欢故事与多面支援，但希望可以描述表演，而不必每次现场唱或演。”再确认大家对角色交流、玩笑与轮流发言的期待。吟游诗人结果不给你控制别人的台词或要求注意的权利，也不要求你在想安静时继续热场；虚构角色能在各种情境参与，玩家仍保留自己的节奏。
paragraphs.en: Tell the table that storytelling and versatile support appeal while you prefer describing performances rather than singing or acting on demand. Discuss expectations for dialogue, jokes and taking turns. A Bard result gives no control over other people’s lines or attention. You can want quiet, too. A broadly involved fictional character does not require a player to maintain the same social pace throughout a session.

title.zh: 与其他十一类职业比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other eleven classes

paragraphs.zh: 吟游诗人这里偏表演与多面支援，牧师偏神圣魔法支援；二者不按谁更关心同伴区分。法师偏研习准备，术士偏自身力量塑形，邪术师偏契约，德鲁伊偏自然变化。野蛮人偏原初投入，战士偏武技，武僧偏身法，圣武士偏誓言，游侠偏路线，游荡者偏精细切口。角色也可以同时讲故事和做这些事。
paragraphs.en: This Bard angle emphasises performance and versatility; Cleric emphasises divine support, without ranking concern for companions. Wizard concerns study, Sorcerer innate shaping, Warlock a pact and Druid nature and forms. Barbarian highlights primal commitment, Fighter technique, Monk movement, Paladin an oath, Ranger routes and Rogue precise openings. Storytelling can coexist with any of them; the selected angles describe options rather than exclusive permission to enjoy a scene.

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的能力
title.en: Counterexamples and abilities not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，你选故事只因为这一次场景适合，未必想扮演主说话者；不选表演也不说明缺乏创意。结果不评魅力值、口才、音乐、领导、受欢迎程度或适合的现实工作，也不保证职业操作简单。不同版本、可用法术和桌面风格影响实际玩法，应另看所用规则，不从趣味计数生成角色能力或团队职位。
paragraphs.en: Selecting a story may fit this occasion without making you the party’s main speaker. Avoiding performance proves no lack of creativity. This result assigns no Charisma score, speaking ability, music skill, leadership, popularity or real occupation, and promises no easy mechanics. Versions and table style affect actual play. Consult the chosen rules separately rather than generating abilities or a party position from an entertainment count.

title.zh: 可选的纸上小尝试
title.en: An optional imaginary tryout

paragraphs.zh: 可选小尝试：为一个虚构出发场景写一句可用的故事概述，再写一种不表演、只提供普通信息的参与方式，可以不实际演出。看看哪一种更吸引你，以及是否愿意长期使用。也可以只喜欢角色设定而不想玩这个职业；读其他完整说明后改变选择很合理，不需要向同桌证明问卷选得准。
paragraphs.en: For an optional tryout, write a one-sentence story contribution for an imaginary departure and an alternative involving ordinary information without performing. Act out neither if unwanted. Notice what appeals and whether it would remain enjoyable repeatedly. Liking a premise without wanting the class is possible. Change your choice after reading other guides without proving to the table that the questionnaire selected the right role.

description.en: Explore a D&D Cleric result through divine support, player choices, eleven comparisons and scoring, without claims about actual belief or caregiving duty.

title.zh: 职业语境与本版游玩角度
title.en: Class context and this edition’s play angle

paragraphs.zh: 牧师在本版的奇幻游戏角度是神圣魔法与同伴支援。神圣是故事和规则里的力量来源，不是测试现实信仰、道德或灵性。你可以喜欢这种魔法画面而没有宗教信仰，也可以有信仰但不想玩牧师。职业名称不赋予现实医疗、咨询或宗教身份；实际信念不在题目输入或计分里。
paragraphs.en: This Cleric angle concerns divine magic and support within a fantasy game. Divine describes a fictional source of power rather than testing actual belief, morality or spirituality. The premise can appeal without religious faith, while having faith does not require enjoying Cleric. A class name confers no medical, counselling or religious role. Actual beliefs are neither collected nor used to assign a result.

title.zh: 计数对应怎样的游玩选择
title.en: Which play choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，你在这些虚构场景里较常选择用神圣魔法支持同伴。可以问自己：吸引你的是魔法主题、与同伴协作，还是想让角色有明确的支援手段？计数不分辨，也不证明现实里擅长照顾别人。你可以同时希望角色有自己的目标、探索和主动戏份，不需要把所有选择都围绕别人安排。
paragraphs.en: A highest count records more fictional choices involving divine support. The magical theme, cooperation or a clear way to contribute may explain the appeal. Counts cannot separate those reasons or establish actual caregiving ability. You may also want personal goals, exploration and active scenes for the character. Enjoying support need not make every choice revolve around someone else’s requests or erase your own interests as a player.

title.zh: 一个具体虚构场景
title.en: A concrete fictional scene

paragraphs.zh: 例如，虚构林地里的队伍正在尝试通过一处魔法阻碍，你想提供神圣支援。先描述希望怎样帮助，再按采用的规则确认可用法术、资源和动作，不假设任何需要都能立刻满足。若角色现在不能或不想使用某项资源，可以讨论别的办法。这个例子关注共同游玩的选择，不让一位玩家承担整场冒险的结果。
paragraphs.en: Imagine a party trying a magical obstacle in a fictional forest. Describe how divine support would contribute, then check available spells, resources and actions under the chosen rules. Not every need can be met immediately. Discuss alternatives if a resource is unavailable or you prefer another use. This is a shared play decision rather than making one player responsible for the outcome of the whole adventure.

title.zh: 选角色前与同桌讨论
title.en: Questions to discuss with the table

paragraphs.zh: 可以先和同桌说：“我喜欢神圣魔法支援，也希望有自己的探索与选择；资源怎样使用我们可以讨论。”确认彼此是否默认某类职业只负责某一件事，而不要等游戏中才发现期待不同。牧师结果不是随时响应的承诺；玩家可以说不、改变角色重点或尝试其他职业，也无需为同伴每次遭遇提供保证。
paragraphs.en: Tell the table that divine support appeals and that you also want exploration and personal choices. Discuss resource expectations before discovering incompatible assumptions during play. A Cleric result is no promise to respond to every request or specialise in only one task. You may decline, change the character’s emphasis or try another class without guaranteeing what happens to companions in every fictional encounter.

title.zh: 与其他十一类职业比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other eleven classes

paragraphs.zh: 牧师与吟游诗人都可有支援角度，前者这里重神圣魔法，后者重表演与多面参与。圣武士偏誓言守护，德鲁伊偏自然变化，法师偏研习准备，术士偏自身魔法塑形，邪术师偏契约。野蛮人偏原初力量，战士偏武技，武僧偏身法，游侠偏路线，游荡者偏精细切口。十二种都不决定玩家是否善良、可靠或体贴。
paragraphs.en: Cleric and Bard can both support: this Cleric angle highlights divine magic, Bard performance and varied participation. Paladin concerns an oath, Druid nature, Wizard study, Sorcerer innate shaping and Warlock a pact. Barbarian concerns primal power, Fighter technique, Monk movement, Ranger routes and Rogue precise openings. None determines a player’s actual kindness, reliability or thoughtfulness, and several of these fictional approaches can appeal at the same time.

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的能力
title.en: Counterexamples and abilities not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，选支援可能因为本次故事需要，并非你总喜欢辅助；选其他职业也不代表自私。结果不推断现实信仰、救助能力、无私、责任感、心理或就业方向，也不是职业强度或队伍配置建议。不同规则版本、角色等级、法术选择与同桌约定会改变实际体验，不能用次数代替这些信息，更不能将虚构治疗当现实医疗建议。
paragraphs.en: Choosing support may suit this story without being a permanent preference; another class does not imply selfishness. The result infers no actual faith, helping ability, selflessness, responsibility, psychology or career. It recommends no power level or party composition. Actual rules, levels, spells and agreements change play and cannot be replaced by counts. Fictional healing is also no actual medical advice or evidence of a player’s capacity to help someone.

Discussion without dice is enough. Notice whether the theme, cooperation or particular scene appeals, and record no desired support if appropriate. paragraphs.en: A highest count records more choices for nature-based magic or forms in imagined situations. title.zh: 选角色前与同桌讨论
title.en: Questions to discuss with the table

paragraphs.en: Ask the table which environments the campaign explores and which rules govern forms if those themes appeal. Discuss how many options you actually want to consult rather than assuming a class is simple or complex from its name. You need not become responsible for every environmental problem or maintain the same attitude toward every fictional creature and forest simply because this questionnaire returned Druid as a high count.

title.zh: 与其他十一类职业比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other eleven classes

description.en: Explore a D&D Fighter result through practised moves, table questions, eleven comparisons and scoring, without actual strength, discipline or courage claims.

title.zh: 职业语境与本版游玩角度
title.en: Class context and this edition’s play angle

paragraphs.zh: 战士在本版的奇幻角度是练熟武技与明确招式，让训练过的角色在合适时机作出选择。它不把玩家的现实身体、纪律或战斗经验变成条件。可以用一句描述表达角色动作，无需示范武器或现实技巧。游戏职业名不是对人的“强硬”评价，也不说明你在生活中只喜欢直接解决问题。
paragraphs.en: This Fighter angle concerns practised martial technique and clear moves made by a trained fictional character. Actual bodily ability, discipline and fighting experience are unnecessary. Describe an action without demonstrating weapons or real techniques. A game class is no verdict of toughness, and choosing it does not establish that direct solutions are your only preference in everyday life. The focus is what you might enjoy playing at a table.

title.zh: 计数对应怎样的游玩选择
title.en: Which play choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，你在这些故事选项里较常选择练熟招式、清楚时机与准备。吸引你的可能是动作容易想象、职业主题鲜明，或希望角色的贡献方式讲得清楚。计数不测规则熟练度，也不承诺战士操作简单、稳定或强。你可以喜欢这个幻想，同时想给角色加入艺术、魔法兴趣或复杂的人际故事。
paragraphs.en: A highest count records more choices for practised moves, timing and preparation. Imagining actions clearly, enjoying a distinct theme or explaining a contribution may account for the appeal. Counts measure no rules knowledge and promise no simple, stable or powerful mechanics. You can enjoy this premise while giving the character artistic interests, curiosity about magic or an intricate personal story; a chosen angle leaves those possibilities open.

title.zh: 一个具体虚构场景
title.en: A concrete fictional scene

paragraphs.zh: 例如，虚构队伍面对一场奇幻考验，你想让角色在一个明确时机使用练熟招式。描述意图之后，仍要按当前规则确认动作、可用装备和结果，不由问卷次数决定成败。也可以先观察或与同伴配合；拥有武技不要求每一幕都动武，更不要求以同一种手段处理交流和探索。
paragraphs.en: Imagine using a practised move at a clear moment during a fictional challenge. After describing the intention, check actions, available equipment and outcomes under the current rules. Questionnaire counts determine no success. Observing or cooperating can come first. A character possessing martial technique need not use force in every scene or resolve conversation and exploration through the same approach, regardless of what the player selected in this quiz.

title.zh: 选角色前与同桌讨论
title.en: Questions to discuss with the table

paragraphs.zh: 可以与同桌说：“我喜欢武技主题和清楚招式，也想知道探索、交流里怎样有自己的戏份。”再询问所用版本、允许的选项和各自想读多少规则，不从“战士适合新手”之类标签替自己决定。喜欢训练有素的角色不等于玩家要做出完美判断；忘记规则、问问题或改变想法都是共同游玩的一部分。
paragraphs.en: Ask how a martial character can participate in exploration and conversation as well as action. Check the version, allowed options and the amount of rules reading you want rather than letting a beginner label decide. Enjoying a trained fictional character requires no perfect player decisions. Forgetting a rule, asking a question and changing an idea are ordinary parts of shared play, with no questionnaire certifying readiness or expertise.

title.zh: 与其他十一类职业比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other eleven classes

paragraphs.zh: 战士这里偏练熟武技，野蛮人偏原初力量，武僧偏徒手身法；三者不是现实训练、力量或自控排名。圣武士偏誓言，游侠偏荒野路线，游荡者偏精细切口。吟游诗人偏表演，牧师偏神圣支援，德鲁伊偏自然形态，术士偏天生魔法塑形，邪术师偏契约，法师偏研习准备。实际人物故事可以跨越这些有限角度。
paragraphs.en: Fighter highlights practised technique, Barbarian primal power and Monk unarmed movement, without ranking actual training, strength or self-control. Paladin concerns an oath, Ranger wilderness routes and Rogue precise openings. Bard concerns performance, Cleric divine support, Druid nature and forms, Sorcerer innate shaping, Warlock a pact and Wizard study. Actual character stories can cross these limited angles; the guide describes selected appeals rather than restricting what a class may care about.

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的能力
title.en: Counterexamples and abilities not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，选清楚招式可能因为这个选项容易理解，并非偏好某套完整机制；不选武技也不说明不勇敢。结果不评体能、领导、纪律、冲动、智力、战斗或现实工作，也不预测游戏表现。实际角色能力取决于规则与建卡，不从人格标签生成；最高并列只是多类相同次数，不能自动推荐兼职业或最佳队伍配置。
paragraphs.en: Choosing a clear move may reflect understandable wording rather than preference for a complete mechanical system. Avoiding martial play proves no lack of courage. The result assesses no fitness, leadership, discipline, impulse, intelligence, combat ability or real occupation and predicts no gameplay performance. Build actual characters under the rules. A highest tie records equal counts rather than prescribing multiclassing or an optimal party composition that the quiz never evaluated.

title.zh: 可选的纸上小尝试
title.en: An optional imaginary tryout

paragraphs.zh: 可选小尝试：给虚构角色写一个你喜欢的武技画面，再写一个完全不靠动武的参与场景，不需要做现实动作。看看清楚招式、角色训练背景和其他故事面向怎样搭配。若只有一幕吸引你，可以继续比较野蛮人、武僧或其他说明；你不需要因为一个战士结果而放弃复杂故事或其他兴趣。
paragraphs.en: For an optional tryout, write one martial image you enjoy and a scene where the character contributes without force. Perform no actual action. Notice how clear moves, a trained background and other interests fit together. Compare Barbarian, Monk or another guide if only one scene appeals. A Fighter result does not require abandoning a complex story or other interests, nor choosing that class for your next campaign.

description.en: Read a D&D Monk result through unarmed style, agile movement, a fictional scene, eleven comparisons and scoring, without actual bodily or spiritual claims.

title.zh: 职业语境与本版游玩角度
title.en: Class context and this edition’s play angle

paragraphs.zh: 武僧在本版的游戏角度是徒手风格、身法与灵活移动。它是一种虚构动作想象，不评玩家身体、协调、体型或修行背景，也不需要练习招式。武僧名称不用于代表真实宗教群体或全部武术传统。喜欢这个职业画面与是否愿意现实运动、冥想或控制情绪没有必然关系，本版不测这些内容。
paragraphs.en: This Monk angle concerns unarmed style and agile movement in a fantasy game. It assesses no actual body, coordination, physique or spiritual background and requires no practice of moves. The class name represents neither a real religious community nor all martial traditions. Enjoying the image establishes no wish to exercise, meditate or regulate emotions, none of which is measured by these fictional play preferences.

title.zh: 计数对应怎样的游玩选择
title.en: Which play choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，你在这些场景里较常选择移动、位置变化与徒手技巧的组合。可以问：吸引你的是画面流畅、人物风格，还是想让角色以不同路线参与？计数不测敏捷属性、反应或决策速度，也不保证实际机制符合想象。你可以先不懂规则，只保留一个想尝试的故事画面，再决定是否深入了解。
paragraphs.en: A highest count records more choices involving movement, position and unarmed style. Flowing imagery, character style or another route through a scene may explain the appeal. Counts measure no Dexterity score, reaction or decision speed and promise no match between imagined and actual mechanics. You can begin without knowing the rules, retain one appealing image and decide separately whether learning the full class would be enjoyable.

title.zh: 一个具体虚构场景
title.en: A concrete fictional scene

paragraphs.zh: 例如，虚构机关厅里出现移动的平台，你想让角色通过灵活身法寻找位置。描述希望到哪里、为什么，再按同桌规则确认能否移动、是否需要检定和代价。问卷不提供现实跳跃方法，也不保证角色忽略所有地形。若平台情节不适合这次游戏，可以换成别的动作场景，而不是勉强要求故事配合结果。
paragraphs.en: In an imaginary mechanism hall with moving platforms, describe where you want the character to go and why. The table determines movement, checks and costs under its rules. This quiz offers no actual jumping technique or guarantee that a class ignores terrain. If the campaign does not suit that image, imagine another scene rather than requiring the story to accommodate a questionnaire result or prove its accuracy.

title.zh: 选角色前与同桌讨论
title.en: Questions to discuss with the table

paragraphs.zh: 可以与同桌讨论：“我想体验移动与徒手风格，想了解本次采用的规则怎样支持这个画面。”也说明自己希望多少描述、多少规则查阅，不必现场表演。角色可以灵活，玩家仍可以慢慢思考、询问和暂停；虚构动作速度与实际作决定的速度不同，更不要求保持冷静、克制或沉默的固定形象。
paragraphs.en: Tell the table that movement and unarmed style appeal, and ask how the chosen rules support that image. Discuss the balance of description and rules lookup without performing it yourself. An agile character can belong to a player who thinks slowly, asks questions or pauses. Fictional action speed differs from actual decision speed and requires no permanently calm, restrained or silent personal image from the player.

title.zh: 与其他十一类职业比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other eleven classes

paragraphs.zh: 武僧这里偏身法移动，战士偏练熟武技，野蛮人偏原初投入，游荡者偏精细切口；画面相近时也可能是不同乐趣。圣武士偏誓言，游侠偏环境路线。吟游诗人偏表演，牧师偏神圣支援，德鲁伊偏自然形态，术士偏自身魔法，邪术师偏契约，法师偏研习。十二类都不能用来排现实灵性、纪律、速度或身体价值。

title.en: Class context and this edition’s play angle

paragraphs.zh: 圣武士在本版的奇幻角度是自选誓言与守护行动，让人物关心的承诺在故事里产生选择。它不是现实道德考试，也不把玩家分成正义或不正义。你不需要立誓、加入信仰或承担保护别人的义务。喜欢一个有承诺的人物，也可以只是喜欢冲突与变化丰富的叙事，而不是希望现实生活有更多规则。
paragraphs.en: This Paladin angle centres on a chosen fictional oath and protection, with commitments creating story decisions. It is no moral examination dividing players into just and unjust people. You need not take an oath, adopt a belief or assume an actual protective duty. An oath-bound character may appeal because commitments create changing narrative tensions, rather than because you want more rules or obligations in everyday life.

title.en: A concrete fictional scene

paragraphs.en: Before a fictional gate challenge, imagine the character considering what an oath asks them to protect, then discussing an approach with companions. Rules determine actual abilities and effects; questionnaire counts confer none and guarantee no protection. Exploring commitment gives you no authority to judge every companion. A shared story still leaves others room for their own character goals, interpretations and decisions at the table.

title.en: Questions to discuss with the table

paragraphs.en: Ask the table how oath-related disagreement can remain fictional rather than becoming moral judgement between players. Confirm the class version and actual rules, and describe wanting a changing character rather than an infallible judge. What a character maintains or reconsiders is a story discussion. A Paladin result requires no obedience from others and makes you responsible for nobody’s actual safety, choices or personal beliefs.

title.zh: 与其他十一类职业比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other eleven classes

paragraphs.zh: 圣武士这里偏誓言守护，牧师偏神圣魔法支援，战士偏练熟武技；这些不是善良程度的排序。野蛮人偏原初投入，武僧偏身法，游侠偏荒野路线，游荡者偏精细切口。吟游诗人偏表演，德鲁伊偏自然形态，术士偏天生魔法，邪术师偏契约，法师偏研习。誓言与契约的叙事不同，也不等于善恶对立。
paragraphs.en: Paladin highlights an oath and protection, Cleric divine support and Fighter practised technique, without ranking goodness. Barbarian concerns primal commitment, Monk movement, Ranger wilderness routes and Rogue precise openings. Bard concerns performance, Druid nature and forms, Sorcerer innate magic, Warlock a pact and Wizard study. An oath and a pact offer different story premises rather than opposing moral categories, and several of these angles may interest the same player.

title.en: Counterexamples and abilities not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，你选誓言只是因为人物故事吸引，并非喜欢所有具体规则；选邪术师也不代表道德相反。结果不推断真实诚信、信仰、政治、牺牲精神、领导、关系责任或现实职业。规则里怎样定义誓言、能力和后果，需要查本桌采用材料，不能由最高次数裁定，也不能用角色说法给现实他人定善恶或要求宽恕伤害。
paragraphs.en: An oath may make an appealing story without making every mechanic enjoyable. A Warlock choice implies no opposite morality. The result infers no actual honesty, belief, politics, sacrifice, leadership, relationship responsibility or career. Consult the table’s material for oath rules and consequences rather than deciding from a highest count. Fictional language supplies no judgement of actual people and no demand to forgive harm or take responsibility for someone else.

paragraphs.zh: 例如，虚构队伍进入一片陌生区域，你想比较通路、留意环境线索，再决定使用什么手段。可以先向同桌问清角色实际知道什么，不把玩家读过的地图自动当角色知识。具体能力、旅行与检定按采用规则处理；若故事没有荒野，也可以讨论这种探索乐趣能否在其他场景出现，不保证每场游戏都合适。
paragraphs.en: Entering an imaginary region, compare routes and environmental clues before choosing an approach. Ask what the character actually knows rather than importing a map the player has seen. Rules govern abilities, travel and checks. If the campaign has no wilderness, discuss whether other scenes can support the exploration you enjoy. The questionnaire promises no fit with every setting and provides no real route or environmental information.

title.zh: 选角色前与同桌讨论
title.en: Questions to discuss with the table

paragraphs.zh: 可以问同桌：“这次故事会有多少探索、旅途和环境互动？我喜欢路线选择，也希望由大家共同决定。”再确认规则版本、实际地图使用方式和允许选项。不需要独自记住一切，也不因“游侠”二字默认必须远离人群。你能同时喜欢交流、城市情节与团队配合，人物风格可以比一段职业摘要丰富得多。
paragraphs.en: Ask how much exploration, travel and environmental interaction the campaign includes, and whether route choices can be shared. Check the version, map use and allowed options. You need not remember every detail alone or avoid crowds because the class name suggests wilderness. Conversation, urban scenes and cooperation can also appeal; an actual fictional character can have more interests than this brief selected play angle describes.

title.zh: 与其他十一类职业比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other eleven classes

paragraphs.zh: 游侠与德鲁伊都能出现自然主题，前者这里偏路线和混合手段，后者偏自然魔法与形态。游荡者偏精细切口，战士偏武技，野蛮人偏原初投入，武僧偏身法，圣武士偏誓言。吟游诗人偏表演，牧师偏神圣支援，术士偏天生魔法，邪术师偏契约，法师偏研习。探索不是游侠专属，也不把其他职业写成不懂环境。
paragraphs.en: Ranger and Druid can share a nature theme: this Ranger angle emphasises routes and mixed approaches, Druid magic and forms. Rogue concerns precise openings, Fighter technique, Barbarian primal commitment, Monk movement and Paladin an oath. Bard concerns performance, Cleric divine support, Sorcerer innate magic, Warlock a pact and Wizard study. Exploration belongs exclusively to none of them, and the comparison establishes no actual environmental competence in a player or character.

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的能力
title.en: Counterexamples and abilities not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，选路线可能只因为想看地图，不一定想处理所有旅行规则；喜欢德鲁伊也可能享受同一段探索。结果不评野外生存、追踪、注意力、独立性、动物关系或现实工作，也不是户外建议。实际玩法随版本、故事比重、具体能力和同桌约定变化，计数不推荐最强构筑、狩猎行为或真实旅程，更不把文化或群体当作角色模板。
paragraphs.en: Choosing a route may reflect liking maps without enjoying every travel rule. Druid can enjoy the same exploration. The result assesses no actual survival, tracking, attention, independence, animal relationship or occupation and gives no outdoor advice. Versions, narrative emphasis and agreements change play. Counts prescribe no optimal build, hunting or real journey, and a game class supplies no template for judging actual cultures or communities.

title.zh: 可选的纸上小尝试
title.en: An optional imaginary tryout

paragraphs.zh: 可选小尝试：画一张只有三个虚构地点的小地图，写两种想让角色比较的路线，以及一项需要问同桌的条件，不查真实地点。看看地图、环境还是混合手段更吸引你。如果只是喜欢旅途故事，也可以由其他职业实现；这个观察帮助讨论游玩偏好，不要求承担导航、户外训练或团队责任。
paragraphs.en: For an optional tryout, sketch three wholly fictional places and two routes your character might compare, plus a condition to ask the table about. Research no real location. Notice maps, environment or varied approaches. Another class can also carry a journey story. Use the exercise to discuss play preferences without accepting navigation, outdoor training or a responsibility for the party simply because this result suggests Ranger.

title.zh: 职业语境与本版游玩角度
title.en: Class context and this edition’s play angle

paragraphs.zh: 游荡者在本版的游戏角度是精细技巧、巧妙切口与适合时机的行动，而不是替现实盗窃或欺骗贴上有趣标签。虚构职业可以有各种人物故事，不强制成为窃贼或背叛者。你不需要开锁、潜入或躲避现实规则；问卷只比较想象中的合作冒险做法，不提供现实操作方法或判断个人可信度。
paragraphs.en: This Rogue angle concerns precise skills, clever openings and timing in a fantasy game, rather than making actual theft or deception appealing. The fictional class can support varied stories without requiring a thief or betrayer. Real lock-picking, intrusion and rule evasion are unnecessary. This quiz compares imagined cooperative approaches, offering no real technique or judgement about how trustworthy the player is outside the story.

title.zh: 计数对应怎样的游玩选择
title.en: Which play choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，你较常选择留意不起眼的机会，用精细小动作参与场景。吸引你的可能是谜题、局部细节，或让角色以不同于正面力量的方式贡献。计数不评聪明、手巧、隐蔽或观察能力，也不确定你会喜欢完整机制。喜欢巧妙人物可以与现实里坦率、遵守约定或不喜欢保密同时存在。
paragraphs.en: A highest count records more choices for unobtrusive openings and small precise actions. Puzzles, details or a contribution other than direct force may explain the appeal. Counts establish no cleverness, dexterity, stealth or observation ability and cannot predict enjoyment of the whole mechanical class. A clever fictional character can appeal to someone who is ordinarily direct, keeps agreements or dislikes secrecy in actual relationships and shared activities.

title.zh: 一个具体虚构场景
title.en: A concrete fictional scene

paragraphs.zh: 例如，虚构藏书室有一道奇幻谜题，你想让角色观察某个小机关并寻找切入口。向同桌描述目标，再由规则确认角色知道什么、具备什么能力和结果怎样。纸上的虚构机关不对应现实锁具；不能从这个例子推断实际方法。若没找到切口，也能问同伴或换成交流，不要求每次都靠个人技巧解决。
paragraphs.en: At a fictional library puzzle, imagine the character examining a small mechanism for an opening. Describe the goal and let the table determine knowledge, abilities and outcomes under its rules. A wholly invented mechanism corresponds to no actual lock or technique. If no opening appears, ask companions or try conversation. The scene need not prove personal skill or require every obstacle to be solved through a precise action.

title.zh: 选角色前与同桌讨论
title.en: Questions to discuss with the table

paragraphs.zh: 可以先问同桌：“我喜欢精细技巧和巧妙切入，想确认我们怎样分享线索、避免一个人包办所有谜题。”也讨论人物秘密是否会影响其他玩家体验，不把职业当作欺骗同桌的许可。角色可以有自己的风格，同时合作、公开讨论和尊重约定；一次游荡者结果不要求你隐藏信息，也不给他人预设不信任的理由。
paragraphs.en: Ask how clues and puzzle participation can be shared rather than making one person solve everything. Discuss whether fictional secrets would affect other players, without treating class identity as permission to deceive the table. A distinctive character can cooperate and discuss openly. A Rogue result requires no hidden information and gives nobody a reason to distrust the player or infer how they would behave in an actual relationship.

title.zh: 与其他十一类职业比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other eleven classes

paragraphs.zh: 游荡者这里偏精细切口，游侠偏环境路线，武僧偏身法移动；不同切入方式不表示谁更机智。战士偏武技，野蛮人偏原初力量，圣武士偏誓言。吟游诗人偏表演，牧师偏神圣支援，德鲁伊偏自然形态，术士偏自身魔法，邪术师偏契约，法师偏研习。所有职业都可参与谜题，不能用这组对照分配现实秘密、诚实或道德。

Bard concerns performance, Cleric divine support, Druid nature and forms, Sorcerer innate magic, Warlock a pact and Wizard study. Every class can take part in puzzles. The comparison assigns no actual secrecy, honesty or morality and reserves no form of clever storytelling exclusively for one class or player.

title.en: Counterexamples and abilities not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，你选小机关可能因为这个题目画面具体，并非喜欢潜行或精细规则；选其他方式也不说明不善观察。结果不评偷窃倾向、欺骗、犯罪、危险、智力、手部能力或现实职业，不推断过去行为。实际角色体验要看版本与同桌材料，不从趣味次数推荐渗透技巧、最强动作或必须扮演的道德阵营。
paragraphs.en: An option about a small mechanism may be concrete without making stealth or detailed mechanics enjoyable. Choosing differently proves no poor observation. The result assesses no theft, deception, crime, dangerousness, intelligence, manual ability or real occupation and infers no past conduct. Consult the actual version and table material rather than deriving intrusion techniques, optimal moves or a mandatory alignment from an entertainment count about a fictional class.

Notice the puzzle, timing or character style. You may prefer group reasoning over specialised mechanics. Read other full guides without using a fictional class choice to demonstrate actual ability or accepting a permanent role as the person responsible for every hidden detail.

title.en: Class context and this edition’s play angle

paragraphs.zh: 术士在本版的奇幻角度是角色自身的天生魔法，以及怎样在故事中塑形。天生属于虚构力量设定，不给现实人排血统、天赋或价值，也不说明玩家不用学习。角色可以拥有完全不同的背景；本版没有出生资料、家庭或情绪输入，更不把魔法来源当成真实能力的解释。
paragraphs.en: This Sorcerer angle concerns magic innate to a fictional character and the appeal of shaping it within a story. Innate is a fantasy premise rather than a ranking of actual ancestry, talent or worth, and implies no exemption from learning for the player. No birth, family or emotional information is collected. A fictional source of magic explains neither a real ability nor why somebody enjoys this particular style of play.

title.zh: 计数对应怎样的游玩选择
title.en: Which play choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，你在这些场景里较常选择让自身魔法根据当下情况变化。吸引你的可能是力量画面、临场选择，或人物逐渐认识自身魔法的故事。计数不分辨这些原因，也不评直觉、创造力、控制力或反应速度。你可以喜欢这个幻想，同时在现实里偏好准备和规则；故事选择不必复制日常性格。
paragraphs.en: A highest count records more choices for shaping the character’s own magic around an imagined situation. Magical imagery, choices in the moment or discovering a character’s power may explain the appeal. Counts assess no intuition, creativity, control or reaction speed and distinguish none of those reasons. Preparing carefully in everyday life can coexist with this fantasy; a fictional choice need not reproduce an actual personality or habitual approach.

title.zh: 一个具体虚构场景
title.en: A concrete fictional scene

paragraphs.zh: 例如，虚构藏书室的谜题变化了，你想让角色将自身魔法调整成新的表现。先说清故事目标，再按采用规则确认有哪些实际选项、资源与限制，不因为“塑形”就任意创造效果。若希望的画面无法直接实现，可以与同桌讨论等价描述或其他办法；问卷既不生成法术，也不保证这一职业能临场解决所有问题。
paragraphs.en: A fictional library puzzle changes and you imagine reshaping the character’s own magic. State the narrative goal, then check actual options, resources and limits under the table’s rules. Shaping is no permission to invent any effect. Discuss another description or approach if the desired image is unavailable. The quiz generates no spells and promises no class that solves every situation in the moment without preparation, constraints or cooperation.

title.zh: 选角色前与同桌讨论
title.en: Questions to discuss with the table

paragraphs.zh: 可以与同桌说：“我喜欢自身魔法与塑形的故事，想了解我们用的规则实际能选择什么。”再确认希望查阅多少法术、如何描述效果，不从“天生”推断玩家应该会得快。角色逐渐了解力量可以慢慢展开，玩家也可以问问题或换主意。你不需要演失控、情绪化或危险，才能让人物符合术士身份。
paragraphs.en: Ask which options the chosen rules actually provide if innate magic and shaping appeal. Discuss spell lookup and effect descriptions without treating innate as a demand that the player learn quickly. A character’s discovery can unfold gradually while the player asks questions or changes direction. Being a Sorcerer requires no portrayal of instability, emotional volatility or danger, and the table need not interpret the player through those fictional stereotypes.

title.zh: 与其他十一类职业比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other eleven classes

paragraphs.zh: 术士、法师和邪术师都可施法，但这里分别偏自身力量塑形、研习准备、契约故事，不是聪明、天赋或道德排序。吟游诗人偏表演支援，牧师偏神圣魔法，德鲁伊偏自然形态。野蛮人偏原初投入，战士偏武技，武僧偏身法，圣武士偏誓言，游侠偏路线，游荡者偏精细切口。近分可比较来源主题，不把它们硬换成现实人格。
paragraphs.en: Sorcerer, Wizard and Warlock can all involve spells: this edition distinguishes innate shaping, studied preparation and pact stories, not intelligence, talent or morality. Bard concerns performance, Cleric divine support and Druid nature and forms. Barbarian concerns primal commitment, Fighter technique, Monk movement, Paladin an oath, Ranger routes and Rogue precise openings. Compare close magical themes without converting them into real personality categories or claiming that a player can enjoy only one source of fantasy power.

The result assesses no ancestry, IQ, emotion, health, self-control, creativity or real occupation and infers no past experience. Actual game rules determine abilities; counts recommend no strongest spell, real training or magical practice. Equal highest counts also prescribe no multiclassing, even when several magical themes appeal together.

paragraphs.en: This Warlock angle concerns a fictional pact, an otherworldly connection and unusual magic. The class name assigns no evil to a player or actual belief, and the character need not follow one moral category. A fantasy pact instructs no real ritual, obedience or exchange. Its mystery can appeal alongside an autonomous cooperative character, with the table deciding which themes belong in the shared story.

title.zh: 计数对应怎样的游玩选择

paragraphs.en: A highest count records more choices where a pact and an external magical connection contribute to the story. The source of power, a fictional relationship or continuing clues may explain the appeal. Counts assess no ambition, secrecy, belief or tendency to be controlled. Liking a premise does not require conflict or every otherworldly theme. You can reject parts of the fantasy without needing a different real identity or a personal explanation for the result.

paragraphs.en: Imagine a clue connected to the character’s pact during a fictional journey. Discuss what the clue means and check actual magical options under the chosen rules, without assuming an otherworldly being supplies every answer. A pact thread can remain mutually agreed fiction without deciding another player’s relationships. It requires no actual promise, offering of belongings or imitation of a ritual, and the questionnaire supplies none of those practices or a magical procedure.

title.zh: 选角色前与同桌讨论

paragraphs.en: Discuss how the source of power appears, unwanted themes and the character’s remaining choices before introducing a pact thread. No uncomfortable scene is required to resemble Warlock. Confirm the rules version and options separately rather than inferring mechanics from the premise. You may revise the background, shorten the thread or choose another class. A questionnaire result establishes no agreement to a narrative arrangement or authority for someone else to decide what you must portray.

Check what the character actually knows and can use; this quiz adds no spells and guarantees no success. Preparation cannot cover every change. paragraphs.en: Ask how much option lookup the chosen rules involve and what recording method would be convenient. Describe how much character management you actually want rather than assuming Wizard requires you to know or remember more. Questions, references and notes can be ordinary parts of play. You need not become the table’s authority, and the fictional character’s professional knowledge remains distinct from what the actual player has learned or can recall.

question.zh: D&D职业测试包括哪十二类、哪个版本？
question.en: Which twelve classes and version does this D&D class quiz use?

answer.zh: 本版选SRD5.2.1的野蛮人、吟游诗人、牧师、德鲁伊、战士、武僧、圣武士、游侠、游荡者、术士、邪术师与法师十二类基础职业。不声称覆盖所有D&D版本、奇械师、子职、物种、阵营或BG3构筑；这里的职业是游戏职业，不是就业分类。
answer.en: This edition selects Barbarian, Bard, Cleric, Druid, Fighter, Monk, Paladin, Ranger, Rogue, Sorcerer, Warlock and Wizard from SRD 5.2.1. It covers neither every D&D version, Artificer, subclasses, species, alignment nor video-game builds. Class means a game class rather than employment.

question.zh: 没玩过龙与地下城也能做吗？
question.en: Can I answer without having played Dungeons & Dragons?

answer.zh: 可以。按更想在虚构合作故事里体验哪种做法选择，不按现实会不会或强不强回答，也没有剧情知识答对。十二份完整说明可先读；真实建卡、法术与规则仍需另外核对本桌采用材料，问卷不替代它们。
answer.en: Yes. Choose what you would enjoy in a fictional cooperative story rather than actual ability, strength or correct trivia. Read all twelve full guides first if wanted. Actual character creation, spells and rules still require the table’s chosen material; this quiz does not replace them.

question.zh: 最高并列、近分和次数怎样理解？
question.en: How do highest ties, close choices and counts work?

answer.zh: 24题全部各选一项，对应的本版职业游玩角度加1，总数24。每题提供十二类中的四类，每类全卷出现8次、每位置2次，未提供的八类不记拒绝。最高计数全部保留完整说明；全选第一项会十二类各2次、十二份完整显示。名单顺序不设主次，不自动指定第二职业；次数不是相似百分比、属性值、战力、适配概率或人口排名。相差一次只是一项选择，不证明显著差异、天赋或固定身份。近分可以自行比较，不补造并列；并列也不自动建议兼职业。本版没有常模、稀有度、科学分界或心理测量验证，故事情境与理解改变时，选择也可以改变。
answer.en: Choose one option for all 24 items; each adds one to its editorial class play angle and counts sum to 24. Four of twelve classes appear per item. Each appears eight times, twice in each position; absent classes are not rejections. Every highest count retains its full guide. Choosing the first option throughout gives two each and all twelve guides. List order establishes no priority or automatic second class. Counts are neither similarity percentages, ability scores, power, fit probabilities nor population ranks. One extra choice proves no significance, talent or fixed identity. Compare close guides without inventing ties; ties prescribe no multiclassing. This edition has no norms, rarity estimates, scientific cutoffs or psychometric validation. Changing stories and interpretations can change choices.

question.zh: 结果能决定真实职业、属性、信仰或道德吗？
question.en: Can a result decide actual work, ability scores, belief or morality?

answer.zh: 这是费马独立创作的24题非官方奇幻游戏问卷，选SRD5.2.1的十二类基础职业，用有限游玩角度解释当前选择。职业指游戏职业，不是现实就业、真实人格或完整规则分类；不包括所有D&D版本、扩展职业、奇械师、子职、物种、道德阵营或BG3构筑。题目、选项、映射、计数、例子与解释原创；职业背景为简要编辑改写，中文为独立翻译，不替代原版游戏规则。未采用IDR60题、竞品正文／算法、官方立绘、其他受保护书题、法术全文或角色素材。只有实际SRD内容适用其CCBY4.0，不扩大到全BasicRules、商标、画作或其他书；本站不声称官方合作、授权或认可。原署名如下：This work includes material from the System Reference Document 5.2.1 (“SRD 5.2.1”) by Wizards of the Coast LLC, available at https://www.dndbeyond.com/srd. Class means a game class, not a real career, actual personality or complete rules taxonomy. The selection excludes other D&D versions, expanded classes, Artificer, subclasses, species, alignment and video-game builds. question.zh: 完整结果、重测和分享免费吗？
question.en: Are full results, retaking and sharing free?

answer.zh: 免费，十二份完整说明可先读，答完24题后最高并列全部完整显示，无需邮箱或其他测试解锁。重测清除本次选择，分享自选且不含答案或次数。后续MBTI需独立重新作答，不从游戏职业结果换算。
answer.en: Yes. Read all twelve full guides first; every highest tie appears after 24 choices, without email or another test to unlock it. Retaking clears this attempt. Optional sharing contains no answers or counts. Further MBTI questions require separate answers rather than conversion from a game class.
